text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Liamine Zeroual invites party leaders for talks on a parliamentary poll date and on the way an independent committee will supervise the elections.
- Opposition parties urge the authorities to open the state-controlled media for them ahead of parliamentary elections planned for this summer.
- The Transitional National Council votes election and privatisation laws on Sunday.
- Algeria to start talks with the European Union over a trade deal with the 15-nation bloc.
- Zeroual resumes talks with party leaders on Tuesday and Wednesday over promised elections.
